title: Implement V4 deterministic Plan and plan-set composition
goal: Validate V4 Plans, compose hash-bound deterministic plan-sets, enforce incompatible boundaries and keep exact Git diff accounting in a separate integration.
acceptanceCriteria: Single Plans are validated strictly with safe target-relative paths, unique obligations and declared dependencies.
Plan-set composition deterministically orders dependencies, binds member paths and byte hashes, and derives exact sorted obligation unions.
Missing dependencies, cycles, duplicate identities, hash drift and forbidden boundary combinations fail closed.
Git diff collection remains outside the local Plan runtime and exact declared-versus-changed path mismatches fail closed.
A reproducible multi-plan fixture and positive and negative P5 tests close the roadmap gate.
Current V3 behavior remains unchanged with no workflow, ruleset or remote change.
